predictions.rationale: Provides the graph model that underlies Use-Case diagrams, managing the actors and use-case nodes and their relationships.
Central class that represents a Use-Case diagram in the UI; ties together model, renderer, and figure classes for actors and use cases.
Responsible for rendering the graphical elements (actors, use cases, relations) specific to Use-Case diagrams.
Defines the figure (shape, appearance, behaviour) used to display an individual use-case within a Use-Case diagram.
Model-layer helper that supplies operations for manipulating use-case elements and their actor relationships.
Creates UML metamodel objects for use cases, actors, extend/include relationships, supporting the feature at model level.
Figure class that visualises «extend» relationships between use cases within the Use-Case diagram.
Figure class that visualises «include» relationships between use cases in the diagram.
MDR implementation of UseCasesHelper; provides concrete behaviour for use-case-specific model operations.
User-interface action that lets users add extension points to use cases, directly supporting editing of Use-Case diagrams.
